channel.title: Pier & Point · Pier 70 Hoedown Yard 1/2 (HDY1/2)
channel.description: Changes, corrections and dated milestones for Pier 70 Hoedown Yard 1/2 (HDY1/2) (Pier 70), San Francisco. Every item names its source.

item.title: Correction · Pier 70 Hoedown Yard 1/2 (HDY1/2): HDY1/2's map use is now mixed, since the D4D shows it commercial in its baseline scenario and residential only in one. The map notes now say the Hoedown Yard is PG&E-owned land outside Brookfield's 28-acre site (with the Assessor lots the D4D gives), that the D4D labels HDY1 and HDY2 separately, and drop an uncited brochure. The yard is no longer called 'former', Resolution 17-45 is described as zoning the whole Special Use District, the Oct 24, 2017 Board hearing is described as scheduled rather than held, and the Item 11A milestone is dated to the Aug 7, 2026 staff report. Source credits no longer say 'adopted 2017' or name OEWD as publisher.

item.title: Correction · Pier 70 Hoedown Yard 1/2 (HDY1/2): The 2017 projection of $736,000 in annual Community Facilities District special taxes from Parcel K North and the Hoedown Yard had been copied identically onto four records (HDY1/2, HDY3, Irish Hill Playground and Parcel K North). It is now listed once in the shared site-wide cost list for Pier 70 as a public investment, and each of the four records points to it.

item.title: Milestone · Pier 70 Hoedown Yard 1/2 (HDY1/2): Port staff report (memo dated Aug 7, 2026) says the Hoedown Yard IRFD tax increment, one of three gap-funding sources for the affordable sites, is 'currently unavailable as market-rate development has yet to occur' (Aug 7, 2026)

item.title: Milestone · Pier 70 Hoedown Yard 1/2 (HDY1/2): Board of Supervisors resolution of intention (File 170880) calls a public hearing for October 24, 2017 on formation of Infrastructure and Revitalization Financing District No. 2 (Hoedown Yard); the Port's Sept 2017 packet only schedules the hearing, and whether it was held that day was not confirmed (Oct 24, 2017)
item.description: Board of Supervisors resolution of intention (File 170880) calls a public hearing for October 24, 2017 on formation of Infrastructure and Revitalization Financing District No. 2 (Hoedown Yard); the Port's Sept 2017 packet only schedules the hearing, and whether it was held that day was not confirmed (Oct 24, 2017). Source: Port of San Francisco, 2017-09-22.

item.title: Milestone · Pier 70 Hoedown Yard 1/2 (HDY1/2): Port Commission consents to zoning the Hoedown Yard (Assessor's Blocks 4120/002 and 4711/008A per the memo) into the Pier 70 Special Use District (Resolution 17-45) and recommends the IRFD (17-49) (Sep 26, 2017)
item.description: Port Commission consents to zoning the Hoedown Yard (Assessor's Blocks 4120/002 and 4711/008A per the memo) into the Pier 70 Special Use District (Resolution 17-45) and recommends the IRFD (17-49) (Sep 26, 2017). Source: Port of San Francisco, 2017-09-22.

item.title: Planned · Pier 70 Hoedown Yard 1/2 (HDY1/2): Port Commission Resolution 17-45 consents to zoning amendments establishing the Pier 70 Special Use District over the 28-Acre Site, the 20th & Illinois Street Parcel and the PG&E-owned Hoedown Yard, and approves the Design for Development, bringing the Hoedown Yard into the SUD land-use and height framework as a future development parcel; the Hoedown Yard is not part of FC Pier 70's 28-Acre Project DDA (Sep 26, 2017)
item.description: Port Commission Resolution 17-45 consents to zoning amendments establishing the Pier 70 Special Use District over the 28-Acre Site, the 20th & Illinois Street Parcel and the PG&E-owned Hoedown Yard, and approves the Design for Development, bringing the Hoedown Yard into the SUD land-use and height framework as a future development parcel; the Hoedown Yard is not part of FC Pier 70's 28-Acre Project DDA (Sep 26, 2017). Source: Port of San Francisco, 2017-09-22.
